basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Minneapolis, Minnesota, exploring the world of VR with my Oculus Quest 2. I work as a software developer during the day and enjoy gaming and watching sports in the evenings. Recently, I've developed an interest in VR and its applications in gaming and beyond. I'm single and usually spend time online after work hours, typically between 6 PM and midnight CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a degree from the University of Minnesota. My interest in technology extends to both software and hardware, often learning through online courses, tutorials, and community forums. My recent intrigue with VR has led me to explore related subreddits and discussions.
